verdict.rationale: Docs confirm OpenCode supports configuring any LLM provider via API keys, plus a curated OpenCode Zen model list, Copilot and ChatGPT Plus/Pro login options, and per-agent model selection; community users corroborate running Claude, Gemini, local llama.cpp/Qwen models, and switching providers/models across sessions. Missing for 10: no independent benchmark of provider switching UX, and community notes model/provider selection across sessions can be 'annoying' with some bugs.
